# exo_safe_attachment_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing SafeAttachmentPolicy object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Maps to the -Action parameter.
- `admin_display_name` (String) Maps to the -AdminDisplayName parameter.
- `enable` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enable parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `make_built_in_protection` (Boolean) Maps to the -MakeBuiltInProtection parameter.
- `quarantine_tag` (String) Maps to the -QuarantineTag parameter.
- `recommended_policy_type` (String) Maps to the -RecommendedPolicyType parameter.
- `redirect` (Boolean) Maps to the -Redirect parameter.
- `redirect_address` (String) Maps to the -RedirectAddress parameter.
